text:
maya: Quick idea: switch console quota timeseries default to 5m buckets for recent ranges to improve anomaly detection for bursty tenants.

arjun: Storage/ingest up ~12x naive. Did you run numbers? :thinking: 

linh: Cardinality from route tags will be the real killer. We should compress tags and avoid wide rows.

maya: Rough calc for top 500 tenants => ~30M points/week at 5m. With compression and tiering could be 3-5x disk.

sara: UX: must not break saved dashboards. Can we expose v2 API and keep v1 stable?

arjun: Yes. v2: GET /v2/tenant/{id}/quota_ts?start=&end=&step=. Response includes meta.step and series_id. Keep /v1 unchanged.

tom: Implementation plan: async aggregator builds 5m buckets -> write tenant_quota_ts_v2. Keep v1 live. Feature-flag read switch. Hot in-memory aggregator for last hour for alerting.

linh: Schema: tenant_id, bucket_start (5m), series_id, metric, value, tags_blob(compressed). Query planner must understand tags_blob.

maya: Retention: keep 5m for 30d, downsample to 1h up to 90d, archive older. Compaction worker runs daily.

arjun: Action items: I'll draft API spec (2d). Linh protos for tag encoding (5d). Tom infra ticket + compaction design (3d). Sara frontend plan + toggle copy (4d).

infra-bot: INFRA-8234: quota for TSDB shards requested.

maya: Thanks — sync tomorrow 10am.
